lines.text: It’s project time! Build a catching game: things fall as clones from random places, the player moves smoothly, catching scores points, and the game ends after a time limit or when lives run out.
Build a catching game: things fall as clones, the player moves smoothly, catching scores points, and the game ends after a time limit or when lives run out.
Make some clones good (stars) and some bad (bombs).
Use pick random to choose each clone’s costume, and a different rule for each.
When time is up or lives reach 0, say the score and stop all.
Playtest and tune the numbers: fall speed, how often clones appear, and the player’s speed.
Fun games are hard but fair.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
